links.outcome: LLM answer accuracy against abstractor consensus on local EMR data for registry questions
links.effect: 87% of LLM answers exactly matched consensus, 2% partially, 9% did not; mean question-level accuracy 91.5% (SD 13.4%); human inter-rater agreement about 98%.
links.quote: In validation, human inter-rater agreement was approximately 98\% while 87\% of LLM answers exactly matched consensus, 2\% partially, and 9\% did not.

unlisted_practices: Categorizing registry questions by ambiguity and required clinical reasoning to predict LLM accuracy
LLM-based identification of candidate data sources to define question-specific document sets for abstraction

screen.reason: Empirical validation of LLM performance for clinical registry abstraction across different levels of clinical ambiguity and document retrieval, compared directly to human consensus ground truth.
